abstract: BACKGROUND: Well-established first-line chemotherapy (such as EMA-CO) is extraordinary active for gestational choriocarcinoma. However, it causes very serious situation once drug-induced acute interstitial lung disease occurs during the treatment. CASE: A 31-year-old Japanese woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma was treated with EMA-CO as an initial chemotherapy regimen for seven cycles. Her beta-hCG dropped from 13,087 ng/ml to 2.2 ng/ml. At 11 days after 7th cycle of EMA-CO treatment, however, she developed respiratory failure, and was diagnosed as having EMA-CO-induced interstitial lung disease with bilateral ground-glass opacity on CT scan, and the examination of the bronchoalveolar lavage fluid. After high-dose steroid therapy, symptoms and ground-glass opacity on CT scan were remarkably improved. She then commenced a regimen of carboplatin (AUC 5) and paclitaxel (180 mg/m2). After completing 8 cycles, her beta-hCG dropped to <0.2 ng/ml. Three additional cycles were administered and the patient remained clinically free of disease, with normal beta-hCG levels for 11 months. CONCLUSIONS: Paclitaxel and carboplatin combination is active and appears to be a viable alternative to EMA-CO combination chemotherapy in metastatic choriocarcinoma even after EMA-CO-induced interstitial lung disease.
abstract_ja:
背景: 確立された一次化学療法であるEMA-COは妊娠性絨毛癌に対して非常に有効である。しかし、治療中に薬剤性急性間質性肺疾患が生じると、非常に重篤な状況を招く。
症例: 転移性絨毛癌の31歳日本人女性がEMA-COを一次化学療法として7サイクル投与された。β-hCGは13,087ng/mlから2.2ng/mlまで低下した。しかしEMA-COの第7サイクルから11日後に呼吸不全を発症し、CTで両側のすりガラス陰影と気管支肺胞洗浄液の検査所見から、EMA-COによる間質性肺疾患と診断された。高用量ステロイド療法後、症状とCTのすりガラス陰影は著明に改善した。その後、カルボプラチン(AUC 5)とパクリタキセル(180mg/m2)のレジメンを開始した。8サイクル終了後、β-hCGは0.2ng/ml未満に低下した。さらに3サイクル投与し、患者は臨床的に無病の状態を維持し、正常なβ-hCG値が11か月間続いた。
結論: パクリタキセルとカルボプラチンの併用は有効であり、EMA-COによる間質性肺疾患を生じた後でも、転移性絨毛癌におけるEMA-CO併用化学療法に代わる実行可能な選択肢と思われる。
